svg.title: Patch Management / System Architecture
svg.desc: Proposed agent-centered architecture with a black background. An administrator interacts with Intillegent deplyment kit, a central deployment agent built on either Pi or OpenCode. The agent uses an LLM and Debian security advisory data, calls MCP tools, requests approval for changes, interprets host evidence and job output, and reports results. An osquery MCP project adapter routes read-only queries over SSH to Debian virtual machines; remote host routing is a project integration. An execution MCP approval facade wraps the Semaphore MCP server, whose task tools use the Semaphore API and Ansible Core to execute approved playbooks over SSH. Agent runtime tool policy and a project approval gate control mutation calls. Recovery uses cached package versions and configuration backups. Solid arrows show requests; dashed arrows show returned data.

g.font-family: Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', 'Liberation Mono', 'Courier New', monospace
g.text: Pi / OpenCode agent | MCP tools | osquery | Ansible + Semaphore | Debian VM fleet
Choose one runtime: Pi OR OpenCode
Agent reports results; Semaphore stores logs.
Install failure: repair APT / capture diagnostics.
Health failure: cached rollback + config restore.
